summary: The registrant, Roma Green Finance Ltd, filed an automatic shelf takedown (424B5) for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $200 million in Class A ordinary shares using H.C. Wainwright as sales agent at a 3% commission. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. The ATM agreement contains no minimum, escrow, or refund provisions, and shares are sold at market prices ($7.765 recent close). Since this is a routine capital-raising mechanism rather than an event-driven catalyst, it does not constitute a special situation.
